claims.statement: [[CustomerPull]] and [[ProductLedWillingnessToPay]] become durable only when distribution systems such as [[CPGDistribution]] can repeatedly deliver the product.

qualifications: Mission language without product performance or operating capacity is not sufficient.
claims.statement: A [[SaaSTrustMoat]] or [[PurposeDrivenBusiness]] can support adoption, but the trust survives only when operating pace and delivery remain credible.

qualifications: These sources do not establish one universally optimal portfolio or trading rule.
claims.statement: [[InvestmentRiskManagement]] and [[StopLossDiscipline]] treat uncertainty, position exposure, and exit rules as more reliable controls than confidence in one forecast.

summary: The business and market sources repeatedly separate attention from durable value: customer pull, distribution, operating capacity, trust, and disciplined risk management determine whether an attractive idea survives contact with real markets.
